Databricks Runtime 17.3 LTS​

Synthetic release notes for tests, powered by Apache Spark 4.0.0.

Behavioral changes​

  • input_file_name function is no longer supported
  • Auto Loader incremental listing default changed
  • Fix case class conversion in array literals

input_file_name function is no longer supported​

The input_file_name function is no longer supported because it is unreliable. Use _metadata.file_name instead.

Auto Loader incremental listing default changed​

The default of the cloudFiles.useIncrementalListing option changed from auto to false. To keep the old behavior, set cloudFiles.useIncrementalListing to auto.

Fix case class conversion in array literals​

In Spark Connect mode, array literals now handle case class values instead of throwing exceptions.

New features and improvements​

A new feature​

The new `thing` function is added and nothing breaks.
